releaseNotes: Platform release: a design uplift across the founder product, guided by a reproduction-then-variation design study (superdesign) and reference research (Refero), with restrained brand imagery generated for the marketing surfaces. The Formation strata motif — fine engraved contour line-work drawn from the product's name — becomes the visual identity: a crisp inline-SVG component appears at low opacity in the Today readiness rail and the Launch definition block, and a generated engraved-plate texture now backs the sign-in story panel, the loading screen, and a rebuilt og.jpg social card. The engine's state, reducer, and catalog are untouched; this manifest advances only to keep root package parity.

Product chrome and data-layer refinements in the same release: the sidebar gains a company stage progression (Stage · Validation with seven quiet segments mirroring the server's workspace-stage vocabulary) and a thin left-rule active-navigation treatment; the topbar becomes a structured context strip (stage, hairline divider, goal). Scores read as instruments — serif numeral over a progress rule with a small tabular annotation (36 / 100) — and fact-table counts render as ledger-style two-digit tabular numerals via a shared formatCount primitive. Recommendation rows gain a calm hover tint; a mobile fix keeps the strata motif anchored inside the readiness rail when the layout stacks. Dev tooling: platform/vite.config.ts honors PORT and FORMATION_WEB_PORT so a dev stack can run beside a local production instance. Checks, 56 domain tests, and the production build pass.
